\# Adds additional next action support for Shared Payment Tokens

\## What’s new

Adds the \[redirect\_to\_url\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/shared-payment/issued-token/object.md?api-version=2026-07-29.preview#shared\_payment\_issued\_token\_object-next\_action-redirect\_to\_url) next action type to the \[SharedPaymentToken\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/shared-payment/issued-token/object.md?api-version=2026-07-29.preview) object.

This change also adds the optional \`use\_stripe\_sdk\` boolean parameter to the \[Create a SharedPaymentToken\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/shared-payment/issued-token/create.md?api-version=2026-07-29.preview#create\_shared\_payment\_issued\_token-use\_stripe\_sdk) endpoint, the \[SharedPaymentToken\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/shared-payment/issued-token/object.md?api-version=2026-07-29.preview#shared\_payment\_issued\_token\_object-use\_stripe\_sdk) object, and the \[Confirm a requested Delegated Checkout Session\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/delegated-checkout/requested-session/confirm.md?api-version=2026-07-29.preview#confirm\_delegated\_checkout\_requested\_session-use\_stripe\_sdk) endpoint.

Set \`use\_stripe\_sdk\` to \`true\` to indicate that you’re using \[Stripe.js\](https://docs.stripe.com/sdks/stripejs-esmodule.md), the \[iOS SDK\](https://docs.stripe.com/sdks/ios.md), or the \[Android SDK\](https://docs.stripe.com/sdks/android.md) to handle next actions on the client side.

If you set \`use\_stripe\_sdk\` to \`false\`, you must also provide a \[return\_url\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/shared-payment/issued-token/object.md?api-version=2026-07-29.preview#shared\_payment\_issued\_token\_object-return\_url), and the API returns a \[redirect\_to\_url\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/shared-payment/issued-token/object.md?api-version=2026-07-29.preview#shared\_payment\_issued\_token\_object-next\_action-redirect\_to\_url) next action for 3DS authentication flows.

\## Why is this a breaking change?

Previously, \[next\_action.type\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/shared-payment/issued-token/object.md?api-version=2026-07-29.preview#shared\_payment\_issued\_token\_object-next\_action-type) on the \[SharedPaymentToken\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/shared-payment/issued-token/object.md?api-version=2026-07-29.preview) only returned \`use\_stripe\_sdk\`. Now, either \`use\_stripe\_sdk\` or \`redirect\_to\_url\` can be returned. If you have an integration that validates or switches on \`next\_action.type\` and only handles \`use\_stripe\_sdk\`, you might need to update your logic to also handle the new \`redirect\_to\_url\` value.

\## Impact

If your integration uses Stripe.js, the iOS SDK, or the Android SDK to handle next actions, set \`use\_stripe\_sdk\` to \`true\` when \[creating a Shared Payment Token\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/shared-payment/issued-token/create.md?api-version=2026-07-29.preview) or \[confirming a requested Delegated Checkout Session\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/delegated-checkout/requested-session/confirm.md?api-version=2026-07-29.preview#confirm\_delegated\_checkout\_requested\_session-use\_stripe\_sdk). If you handle next actions outside of a Stripe client-side SDK, set \`use\_stripe\_sdk\` to \`false\` and include a \`return\_url\` to redirect your customers back to your application after completing 3DS authentication.

entries.title: Adds additional next action support for Shared Payment Tokens
entries.quote: Adds the `redirect_to_url` next action type to the `SharedPaymentToken` object. This change also adds the optional `use_stripe_sdk` boolean parameter to the `Create a SharedPaymentToken` endpoint, the `SharedPaymentToken` object, and the `Confirm a requested Delegated Checkout Session` endpoint.
